# Report API Test Examples

## Endpoint

```
POST http://localhost:9200/report/generate
Content-Type: application/json
```

---

## Tuition Fee

        "studentInfo": {
            "studentId": "000000",

            "contactName": "Mrs Ccccc Ddddd",
            "address": "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx",
